The function should output the highest score among all simple paths from vertex 1 to vertex N.

The specification needs to be revised to:
1. Ensure the function computes paths based on non-decreasing sequences of vertex values.
2. Track and count distinct integers in these sequences to determine the score.
3. Output the highest score among all valid paths from vertex 1 to vertex N.
